Music: Featuring 9 events spanning eastern and western music — Tarangini, Acoustics, Acapella, Carnatic Vocals, and Instrument events — the Music cluster is Festember's melodic heart, inviting singers and instrumentalists from across the country.
Dance: Featuring 5 electrifying events — Choreo-Nite Western (₹1,00,000 prize), Choreo-Nite Eastern, Solo Eastern, Solo Western, and Duet Freestyle — the Dance cluster is Festember's most crowd-pulling celebration of grace, rhythm, and performance.
Dramatics: Two standout events, Theatrix and Improvathon, command the stage with selective participation and performances spanning a wide range of genres. Every act captivates and leaves the audience craving more.
Arts: A vibrant showcase of creativity and imagination, the Arts cluster brings together talented artists from across the country to express themselves through diverse forms of visual art, making Festember a colourful hub of innovation and inspiration.
English Lits: A literary battleground with 8+ events — 5 quizzes, Debate, Dumb Charades, Scrabble, Crossword, and JAM — English Lits challenges word enthusiasts across all formats, offering prizes worth over ₹1 lakh.
Tamil Lits: With 11 events spanning Therukuthu, Kavithidal, Kolam, Kalakkal Galata, and more, Tamil Lits celebrates the richness of Tamil language and culture — from elocution and street plays to quizzes and poetry.
Hindi Lits: With 10+ events — Debate, Creative Writing, Jashn-E-Mousiki, Bluff Master, and more — Hindi Lits is a spirited cluster for Hindi enthusiasts offering prizes worth ₹45,000 and drawing participants from 20+ colleges.
Telugu Lits: Telugu Lits features 4 engaging events — Tollywood Movie Quiz, Dumb Charades, Elocution, and Literature Quiz — a fun, spirited platform for Telugu enthusiasts to celebrate their language, cinema, and cultural pride.
Photography: Two major events — Trichy Tilt (online, ₹45,000 prize, 800+ entries previously judged by Bear Grylls) and Live Photography during the fest — make this cluster a prime draw for photography enthusiasts nationwide.
Fashion: Two iconic events — Fashionistas (₹40,000 prize) and Mr & Miss Festember — give aspiring models and personalities a stunning platform before thousands, judged by industry experts in one of Festember's most glamorous clusters.
Proshows: Four electrifying nights — semi-classical opening, rock bands, international DJs, and a Bollywood grand finale — featuring artists like Neeti Mohan, Sunidhi Chauhan, and Thaikkudam Bridge. Free entry, massive crowds, unforgettable every year.
Gigahertz: A premier western music band competition held in Bangalore and Chennai, with grand finals at NIT Trichy.
FFL: The Festember Football League is a two-day outreach extravaganza held in major cities, bringing passionate football enthusiasts together in a short league format. Since 2017, every edition has been an overwhelming crowd favourite.
Rolling Reels: Rolling Reels Film Festival is Festember's cinematic outreach event, bringing together short film enthusiasts and aspiring filmmakers for screenings, competitions, and discussions across cities before the main fest.
